# CodeSquad

> CodeSquad is an AI automation and software development agency that builds connected growth systems — websites, CRM/dashboards, Google & Meta ads, AI agents/automation, and SEO/AEO/GEO content — for clinics, med spas, dental practices, e-commerce brands, and IT & engineering companies. Systems are built into the client's existing stack (no rip-and-replace) and handed over as theirs to run. Founded by Shahzaib Hamid (PhD, Applied AI); team of 10 engineers based in Lahore, Pakistan, serving clients across the US, Canada, UK and UAE.

For the complete, unabridged text of every page, case study and article on this site in one file, see [/llms-full.txt](https://www.codesquad.ai/llms-full.txt).

## Company

- [Home](https://www.codesquad.ai/): Overview of CodeSquad's growth systems, capabilities (websites/software, CRM & dashboards, Google/Meta ads, SEO·AEO·GEO, AI agents & automation, marketing intelligence), headline case studies, client metrics and testimonials.
- [Founder — Shahzaib Hamid](https://www.codesquad.ai/founder): Founder & CEO profile — PhD in Applied AI, prior clinical gait-analysis research (IEEE Access 2024, ICT Express 2026), 10-person engineering team, publications and background.
- [How Our Process Works](https://www.codesquad.ai/process): The two-phase engagement model — a one-time Build phase (audit, CRM/stack setup, website, automations, campaign launch, training) followed by a monthly Grow retainer (ad management, optimization, content/SEO·AEO·GEO, reporting) — plus the 5-step delivery timeline and FAQ on pricing, contracts and timelines.
- [Send an Inquiry](https://www.codesquad.ai/inquiry): Contact/consultation request form; replies within one business day. Also bookable directly via Calendly (https://calendly.com/code_squad/30min).

## Industries

- [Industry Solutions Overview](https://www.codesquad.ai/industry): The same connected growth engine configured for three verticals — Aesthetics/Medical Clinics, E-commerce, and IT & Engineering.
- [Aesthetics & Medical Clinics](https://www.codesquad.ai/aesthetics): Patient-acquisition system for med spas, aesthetic/laser clinics and cosmetic dermatology — treatment-based Google Ads, 3-second lead response, 14-day automated nurture, SEO/AEO/GEO content and booking, built into existing booking software (e.g. PatientNow).
- [Clinics & Dental Practices](https://www.codesquad.ai/clinics): The same patient-growth system tailored to small medical clinics and dental practices — local Google Ads, instant follow-up and online booking built into the practice software already in use.
- [E-commerce Growth System](https://www.codesquad.ai/ecommerce): Growth system for online stores and DTC brands — Shopping/search ads, abandoned-cart and post-purchase flows, email/SMS marketing, and unified ROAS/LTV analytics.
- [IT & Engineering Growth System](https://www.codesquad.ai/it-engineering): Web/software development, CRM, AI agents & automation, IoT integrations and SEO/AEO/GEO for IT firms, engineering companies and technical teams; plans from $499/mo.

## Case Studies

- [Harmony MedSpa](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/harmony-medspa-patient-growth-automation): 24/7 patient-growth and follow-up system for a Sarasota, FL med spa — 60-second lead response, 14-day nurture, 60+ leads and 6–7 new patients in 2 months, ~$50 cost per lead.
- [CareInn Dental Clinic](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/careinn-dental-clinic): Patient-growth system live before the clinic's first day of operation — automated capture, 60-second response, 14-day follow-up, growing patient volume from zero.
- [ENERGYbits](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/energybits): Marketing-intelligence platform unifying 15+ ad/content platforms with automated blog pipelines and pre-publish SEO/AEO/GEO scoring for a DTC wellness brand.
- [iPromo](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/ipromo): Automated product-of-the-month image pipeline integrated with Salesforce and email for a 25-year-old B2B promotional-products company.
- [GengyveUSA](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/gengyveusa): Unified SEO, paid-ads and review-analysis intelligence layer for a veteran-owned healthcare e-commerce/oral-care brand.
- [Modern Law](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/modern-law): Self-publishing content engine generating blogs, social posts and images across four law-firm brands from one pipeline.
- [TriState Auto Sales](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/tristate-auto-sales): Omnichannel AI chatbot and CRM system unifying website chat, social and phone conversations into one lead-routing and booking pipeline for an auto dealer.
- [RTM Kinetics](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/rtm-kinetics): Patient CRM and remote-monitoring system for physical therapy — lead capture, automated reconnect campaigns and real-time therapist dashboards.
- [Law Signal](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/law-signal): Automated pipeline turning law-firm case files into press-ready videos, releases and SEO/AEO-optimized publishing, synced with the firm's CRM.
- [Mama's Compass](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/mamas-compass): AI-scored product aggregation and comparison platform pulling live pricing/stock data from multiple retailers, with auto-generated SEO content.
- [SettleIn](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/settlein): OCR- and AI-driven document processing and eligibility-scoring platform replacing manual application review.
- [Debate Partners](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies/debate-partners): AI case-generation and CRM/billing platform for competitive debate teams — turns research sources into evidence-backed, citation-ready cases.
- [All Case Studies](https://www.codesquad.ai/case-studies): Full index of production systems built for healthcare, legal, automotive, e-commerce and other clients.

## Blog

- [All Articles](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog): Practical perspectives on AI automation, SMEs, AEO/SEO, lead generation, software development and scaling operations.
- [Your SaaS Is Being Recommended by AI](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/saas-ai-recommendations-seo-ai-search): Seven strategies to make a SaaS product easier for AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to understand, trust and recommend to buyers.
- [The Fully-Booked Business](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/the-fully-booked-business): A ten-question self-assessment for med spas, clinics, salons and wellness businesses to find where interested leads quietly disappear.
- [SEO Isn't Dead — But Your SaaS SEO Playbook Probably Is](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/ai-seo-for-saas): The 2026 AI-SEO playbook for SaaS — extractable content, original data, comparison pages, transparent pricing and measuring AI citations.
- [I Used Claude to Turn a Messy Spreadsheet Into a Useful Dashboard](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/claude-messy-spreadsheet-to-dashboard): A step-by-step walkthrough of cleaning inconsistent spreadsheet data with Claude and building a live dashboard from it.
- [One Prompt, One Studio: HyperFrames + Claude Video Creation Guide](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/hyperframes-claude-ai-video-creation-guide): How the open-source HyperFrames framework paired with Claude Code turns plain-English prompts into edited, rendered video.
- [SEO, AEO and GEO: A Beginner's Guide to AI Search](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/seo-aeo-geo-ai-search-guide-2): How SEO, Answer Engine Optimization and Generative Engine Optimization work together to get a business found by Google and recommended by AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Gemini.
- [How Businesses Lose Money to Slow Lead Response](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/how-businesses-lose-money-slow-lead-response): Why slow follow-up and fragmented sales/marketing visibility silently cost businesses paid-for leads, and how centralized dashboards fix it.
- [Stop Chasing AI Trends](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/stop-chasing-ai-trends-ai-implementation-guide): How to identify the automations that create measurable ROI instead of chasing every new AI trend.
- [Why SMEs Need Digital Transformation](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/why-smes-need-digital-transformation): Why small and medium businesses need automation, AI and data-driven systems to stay competitive.
- [From "Microneedling Near Me" to Booked: The SEO Strategy for Med Spas](https://www.codesquad.ai/blog/microneedling-seo-med-spas): How med spas connect microneedling search demand to booked appointments — service pages, local SEO, AEO/GEO, Google Ads, and lead follow-up automation.
